$comment: The permission profile every Claude Eindri is launched with (plan 239 P5c). A worker runs unattended in its own Yggdrasil worktree, so it may edit and run commands without a prompt (the same latitude opencode workers get from OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT permission *:allow), while the moves that only the Allfather makes, or that destroy unrecorded work, are denied. Deny rules win over allow rules. Appended 2026-11-20: the seat runs in dontAsk mode, so a tool outside this allow list is denied, never asked about; bin/seat/claude-seat.sh adds one allow per configured MCP server at launch. THE COMMAND TIME LIMIT (2026-11-20, "yes not to small tho"): a Bash call defaults to 2 minutes and may declare at most 10, which is short enough that a real build is killed and long enough that a hung ssh hides for hours. 30 minutes by default, 2 hours when a build or a gate suite declares it, never unlimited — the same numbers as bin/agents/cmd-limit-lib.sh, which is where the brief rule and the arm's judgement read them.
